after.name: MaddAddam (Craker engineered subsistence)

scope.continuity: Named literary work and stated period only
scope.exclusions: Ordinary human survivors have different needs; dead people and every grazing action are not workers or leisure beneficiaries.

after.description:
Crakers are engineered to eat grass and leaves, reducing the need for agriculture, while they still fish for Snowman, learn craft and live with danger. This is a functional biotech reduction of subsistence labor rather than a claim that natural grazing is a factory. The guarantee best guess allows a partial direct-access floor, qualified by safety and environmental dependence. Their engineered needs do not automatically remove every useful contribution.

 Decentralized biological resident agency receives strongly positive control weight. Human-derived engineered people are not an external AI workforce, and Crake’s creation does not prove continuing posthumous ownership. The moderate nonworking scenario counts care, useful craft, food provided to others and community creation while distinguishing private feeding and self-maintenance. The disappearance of agriculture is not copied into a participation percentage. The proxy population is specifically active Crakers, not all surviving humans. Broad intervals preserve the reduced-needs mechanism and the uncertain balance of leisure and meaningful social work.

after.society: We (the One State’s compulsory industrial order)

scope.continuity: Named literary work and stated period only
scope.period: The functioning One State before any final interpretation
scope.population: Living biological human One State residents
scope.exclusions: Scheduled duties count even if replaceable; synthetic food and mechanized rhetoric do not prove universal leisure.

after.description:
The One State combines synthetic food with compulsory scheduled work and industrial discipline. Its material technology has conquered agricultural hunger in the regime’s account, yet real assigned roles remain central. The guarantee best guess allows a partial ordinary floor, qualified by coercion, status and bodily insecurity. Synthetic provision is not automatically a secure lifetime right or evidence that every resident avoids contribution.

 Concentrated human institutional authority receives control near the elite reference point. A mechanized style of life is not itself proof of an unrelated AI sovereign. The low nonworking scenario counts industrial work, administration, maintenance, services, care and useful creation. Assigned duties still count when inefficient, ceremonial or technologically replaceable. The regime’s schedules are not a complete all-age census, and time permitted for private activity is not the share of nonworkers. This zero variant preserves the classic overlap of advanced provision and enforced work without equating obedience with shared productive ownership.

before.reason: Compulsory industrial work and synthetic food are supported, but a displaced-labor alternative is not yet established.
before.analysis: The Tables synchronize work, and petroleum food is credited with ending agricultural hunger. These establish technology and coercion, but the narrator's image of people as machine parts is not evidence that machines do their jobs unaided. A totalitarian industrial society is not automatically a zero variant. The war's huge loss of life also cannot become a nonworking share.
before.follow_up: Find explicit production automation, reduced labor requirements or a policy retaining unnecessary work. If established, retain a zero variant with its actual access conditions; otherwise keep an industrial-discipline comparison. Distinguish narrator praise from institutions.
